game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Sand Dunes – Sandstone Arch, a natural sandstone arch: the caravan guide must handle vultures while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Pseudocode Bridge: Convert plain-language pseudocode into working code steps to cross the gap.
theme: Sand Dunes – Sandstone Arch: a natural sandstone arch
core_gameplay_loop: In Sandstone Arch, repeat each round: Convert plain-language pseudocode into working code steps to cross the gap. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the bridge value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Chain 9 consecutive correct decisions about bridge to power up the caravan guide and open the sandstone arch.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 5 (applied tier): Pseudocode Bridge
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Pseudocode Bridge' (Week 9 slot 11), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Sandstone Arch'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how bridge changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against vultures in Sandstone Arch.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 9.
